author: Inside Edition
description: Sophia Maddox, 26, found out that her grandfather is the notorious Charlie Manson. In 1969, Manson ordered his cult followers, known as "The Family," to murder actress Sharon Tate, who was eight months pregnant, and six others during a two-night reign of terror in Los Angeles. Maddox learned her grandfather was Manson when her dad took an ancestry DNA test. Her journey is explored in a new Hulu documentary, "My Grandfather Charles Manson."
title: Woman Discovers Charles Manson Is Her Grandfather

author: Inside Edition
description: Fans, family and some famous friends gathered to give musician Oliver Tree a final sendoff over the weekend in California. The singer and rapper died in a helicopter accident in Brazil on June 14th. His mother, Christine Begin Nickell, told the gathered crowd, "The overwhelming outpouring of love and support since Oliver's passing has been a profound source of comfort. I have witnessed humanity at its very best."
title: Logan Paul, Diplo Share Memories At Oliver Tree's Celebration Of Life
